title: Construct the scores without claiming to learn the model promise
statement: Explicit finite independent pair tables are double-centered and folded into node terms; conditional second/third/fourth moment accumulators construct influences and local kappa without joint-space enumeration. For a PROMISED unbiased quadratic, base+all-flip differences D_i give E D_i^2=I_i,Var(D_i^2)<=2I_i^2. MOM block ceil(8/eta^2),odd count>=8log(n/alpha) yields simultaneous relative scores; eta1/3 and top min(n,ceil(72k/epsilon^2)) earn the near-risk guarantee on calibration success. Selected pair/global-sign contrasts and character-design intercept recover only the chosen predictor. Scalar evaluations cost O(n eta^-2 log(n/alpha)+n+L^2), plus each source evaluation andTheta(n) dense input submission. The actual scientific-worker audit reports frozen main-TeX SHA8ecbdf08bcdcf2b40dc09a5da8a445e750791a688861b5c76e4ffb43dc2f2f33; that TeX/original audit body is not acquired here. The22304-call MOM diagnostic and finite truth-table checks are reports, not operational advantage or identification of the quadratic promise.

costs: With s listed quadratic coefficients, scores O(s+n) arithmetic/O(n) storage, linear selection or O(n log n) sorting, then L physical observations plus O(L+s_T) prediction work. Dense input costsTheta(n^2) to read.

General list L=min(n,ceil(3 kappa d^2 k/epsilon^2)),d>=2,0<epsilon<=1; unbiased quadratic improves to min of n,ceil(36k/epsilon^2),ceil((16k/epsilon)log(32e/epsilon)). At10% tolerance the latter is about1083k before cap.
